name: Field of Life
rationale: Allied sustenance stands opposite decay while living light, Nature and honey sustain a field that heals life and hurts undead.

parts.rationale: Native healing ingredient; optional Iron Holy focus

clues: Outer Plinths hold living light, nature focus; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the second outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Leave the fourth outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Living light follows blank inscription clockwise.
Ally sustenance follows living light clockwise.
Honey motif follows ally sustenance clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Nature focus follows honey motif clockwise.
Enemy decay follows nature focus clockwise.
Blank inscription follows enemy decay clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Ally sustenance stands opposite enemy decay.
